entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Once a single mana-rich plane, torn apart by an unknown planeswalker into five incomplete shards.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of rolling hills, forests and glittering beaches dotted with high-rising castles.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of sophisticated beauty etched into every artifact, city and inhabitant.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A hellish shard whose inhabitants buy power at a high price or spiral into despair.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard where goblins, lizardmen and humans scour for food and power, ruled by fearsome dragons.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of lush growth whose beauty masks the savage dangers of the jungle.

entities.name: Shards of Alara
entities.description: Five incomplete planes into which Alara broke along color lines.

entities.name: Unknown planeswalker
entities.description: The unnamed planeswalker who tore Alara asunder millennia ago, harvesting its mana.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker whose origins on Alara are the subject of the Flight of the White Cat webcomic.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A Bant character featured on a List card.

events.summary: An unknown planeswalker tears the single plane of Alara asunder millennia ago, harvesting its mana.
events.quote: for an unknown planeswalker tore the plane asunder millennia ago, harvesting of its mana

events.summary: The disaster breaks Alara along color lines into five shards, which recover their mana only in part.
events.quote: This disaster broke Alara along color lines into incomplete planes called shards

events.summary: The Flight of the White Cat webcomic tells of Ajani's origins on Alara.
events.quote: Flight of the White Cat is a webcomic about Ajani 's origins on Alara .
